# Two OTA app slots (ota_0/ota_1) + otadata instead of a single "factory"
# image: an OTA writes the new image into the INACTIVE slot and only
# switches esp_ota_set_boot_partition() over once it verifies
# running image is never overwritten in place. OTA is implemented over the
# admin channel (components/admin_channel/
# half of the contract is confirm_app_if_pending_verify() in
# main/poe_luminaire_main.c + CONFIG_BOOTLOADER_APP_ROLLBACK_ENABLE. See
# README.md "OTA update".
# "nvs" holds two product-owned NVS namespaces: the admin channel's secret
# (namespace "devid"
# DMX layer's config (namespace "dmx" -- see components/dmx_input/). Both
# are "factory-resettable" state on purpose -- FACTORY_RESET
# (admin_channel.c) erases this whole partition
# the admin secret to the compiled-in factory default (devid_init()
# rewrites it automatically on the next boot) and the DMX config to its
# disabled default. hv9910 does NOT use NVS: the LED always boots off and
# its level comes from the network. The serial is NOT stored here (or
# anywhere) -- it's recomputed from the MAC at every boot
# nvs is 0x14000
